$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-calendar) and how to read it.

root.$why: Figma's Calendar is one month with 12 px padding; in code the surface (.ds-calendar) holds one or more .ds-calendar__month, which carry the padding and the 16 px gap.

Row.$why: Figma clips each week to a 6 px radius so a range band rounds at the row's ends; in code the end days round themselves (no clipping, so the focus ring stays visible). The week is a 7-column grid, not an auto-layout.

weekday.$why: The header has no fill, so its radius draws nothing; one line of text needs no gap.
